contract: The Python and TypeScript SDKs expose report_snapshot as read-only list, detail, and report-type-filtered reads.
findings: The report generator stores a hashed, unfrozen draft with public-interest context.
The report snapshot has a governed draft/submitted/verified/published/rejected lifecycle.
The authenticated Gateway report-review endpoints currently provide scoped reads only.
No repository callsite uses SDK report create, bulk-create, update, or delete methods.
change: Removed generic create, bulk-create, update, and delete operations from both SDK ReportMethods surfaces. Preserved list, get, and list_by_type/listByType. Report generation remains in the exporter service.
scope_limits: SDK calls were mocked; no database, provider, candidate, or legacy service was used.
This does not add Gateway report generation or reviewer lifecycle transition routes.
Capability classifications and MAN-CAP acceptance remain unchanged.
rollback: Restore report mutation methods only after the Gateway provides authenticated generation and reviewer-transition operations that enforce the report snapshot lifecycle and preserve hash/context invariants.
